body:
This issue needs clarification before autonomous execution:

1. This ticket declares hard dependencies on #49, #50, and #51 — all three must exist before this work can begin. However, none have merged yet (PRs #55, #56, and #57 are still open). Should autonomous processing wait until all three dependencies merge to main, or should work begin on a branch that builds on top of the dependency branches?

This issue is labeled autonomously-nightly but cannot proceed without answers to the above.
Once resolved, re-run the nightly workflow or remove the label and work on it manually.
